user.title: mBenzin access key
user.description: Enter your personal access key for mBenzin.cz. You can get it for free by e-mail: write to reklama@mbenzin.cz, say you use the prices in Home Assistant, for which city or stations, and how often you load them. The key is personal, never share it. Ceny paliv is an independent project; the prices come from mBenzin.cz, which is not involved in this integration.

data_description.key: The key mBenzin.cz sent you. Paste it whole, without spaces.

city.title: Town
city.description: Choose the town. Only the stations of this town are shown, not those of the whole region.

fuels.title: Fuels and language
fuels.description: Pick one or more fuels – for example Natural 95 and LPG for a dual-fuel car. Each fuel gets its own sensors. Note that mBenzin does not distinguish E10: the Natural 95 price applies to all 95-octane petrol.

data_description.language: Sets the language of the labels in the ready-made dashboard views (for example "My station"). The language of this setup follows Home Assistant's language.
data_description.max_age_days: Small stations update their prices rarely. Keep the ones whose price is up to 3 or 7 days old in the list, with the date shown.

station.title: Favourite station – {fuel}
station.description: Your usual station in {city} for {fuel}. It gets its own sensor with price history, trends and its rank. Leave "—" for none.

logos.title: Station logos (optional)
logos.description: Tick the chains whose logos you want on the card. They are downloaded from the Ceny paliv logo pack on GitHub into your Home Assistant config folder (a few KB each). The chains of your city are preselected. Logos are trademarks of their owners and are shown only to identify the stations; this project is not affiliated with them. Untick everything to use letter badges instead.

mode.title: Kind of place
mode.description: Follow a **town** of the mBenzin list, or **a point on the map with a radius** (for example around your home, or a town that mBenzin splits into districts). The top 5 and the map cover the stations of that place.

point.title: Point and radius
point.description: Move the marker on the map and set the radius: every station inside the circle is included. The default is your Home Assistant location and 10 km.

data_description.name: Shown in the card and in the names of the sensors. Leave empty for the coordinates.

reauth_confirm.title: Reauthenticate
reauth_confirm.description: mBenzin.cz no longer accepts the access key of {title}. Enter a new personal key (e-mail reklama@mbenzin.cz if you do not have one).

source.title: Where is the point?
source.description: Pick the centre of the place: a point on the map, your Home Assistant home, a person or device that moves (the area follows it), or a zone.

point_home.title: Around your home
point_home.description: Every station within the radius of your Home Assistant home location is included.

data_description.name: Shown in the card and in the names of the sensors. Leave empty for a default name.

point_person.title: Around a person or device
point_person.description: The area moves with the person or device (for example the Home Assistant app on a phone) once it is about 1 km away from the last centre, from the prices already downloaded: no extra request to mBenzin. If its location is unknown, the area stays at home.

data_description.name: Shown in the card and in the names of the sensors. Leave empty for a default name.

point_zone.title: Around a zone
point_zone.description: The centre of the zone is the centre of the area. If the zone is moved, the area follows it.

data_description.name: Shown in the card and in the names of the sensors. Leave empty for a default name.

error.invalid_auth: mBenzin did not accept the key. Check that it is pasted whole and without spaces.
error.cannot_connect: Cannot reach mBenzin.cz. Please try again.
error.rate_limited: mBenzin returned HTTP 429 (limit: 20 pages per hour). Try again in a moment.

abort.single_instance_allowed: The integration is already set up. To follow another town or point, open it and use "Add place".
abort.reauth_successful: The new access key works. The prices will refresh now.

options.map: A point on the map (or typed coordinates)
options.person: A person or device that moves with me

invalid_auth.message: mBenzin.cz does not accept the access key. Enter a new key.

update_failed.message: The prices could not be loaded from mBenzin.cz ({errors}).

refresh_failed.message: The prices could not be refreshed: {failed}.

entry_not_found.message: No Ceny paliv entry with the id {entry_id}.

no_data.title: No new prices from mBenzin.cz
no_data.description: {title}: no fresh prices for {fuels} since {since}. The sensors are unavailable until mBenzin.cz answers again. Check that [mBenzin.cz]({url}) is reachable and that your access key is still valid (Home Assistant asks for a new one if it is refused).

person_missing.title: Followed person or device not found
person_missing.description: {title}: the person or device {entity} does not exist any more. The area stays at your home until you choose another one (Configure, or the place in the integration).

zone_missing.title: Followed zone not found
zone_missing.description: {title}: the zone {entity} does not exist any more. The area stays at your home until you choose another one (Configure, or the place in the integration).

invalid_location.title: The centre of a place cannot be found
invalid_location.description: {title}: its coordinates are not usable. The last known centre is kept. Choose the place again in the integration.

refresh.name: Refresh prices
refresh.description: Loads the prices from mBenzin.cz now. Data downloaded less than 30 minutes ago is not downloaded again.

config_entry_id.name: Entry
config_entry_id.description: The Ceny paliv entry to refresh. All entries when empty.
